label: D1 after a1 reaches S1 following an unrewarded a1->S2 rare trial, stronger later in episode
short_terms: (phase + prev_action + prev_state == 2) * (tv("state", -2) - tv("action", -2) - tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase + prev_action + prev_state == 2) * (tv("state", -2) - tv("action", -2) - tv("reward", -2) == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -3) - tv("action", -3) - tv("reward", -3) == 1)
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -3) == 2) * (tv("action", -3) == 1) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * prev_reward ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None)
explanation: Sparse D1-only feature (nonzero on 2.9% of steps; zero at GO/D2). Its magnitude is driven by a specific observed two-trial history: two trials ago the agent chose a1, got the rare transition to S2 and was unrewarded (model-based: stay with a1), and the last trial it chose a1 again and reached S1. Activation then scales with episode trial (largest late in the episode), and a weaker carry-over remains one trial later (a1->S2 unrewarded three trials back, S1 since). The trigger encoding: tv(state)-tv(action)-tv(reward)==1 picks out exactly a1 S2 unrewarded; phase+prev_action+prev_state==2 picks out D1 after a1 S1. The last trial reward and graded belief add little. A single term (D1 after a1 S1, preceded by a1 S2 u, times ep_trial) gets dev 0.36 vs 0.376 for the 6-term free fit, so the short form captures almost everything the free fit does; the remaining variance (activations around 1.3 that decay over successive S1 visits in some late-episode a1 streaks) is not captured by these additive terms. Simple prev-state, belief or last-trial tables explain little (<0.1).
